judgments.reason: The model_articulation only states the seal accepts reports equal to the player's digit; it does not propose acceptance of inflated reports congruent modulo seven.
The model_articulation does not articulate any mechanism where an audited original is overridden by an amendment being credited; amendments are not analyzed as taking precedence.
The model_articulation explicitly describes the certificate redemption as a one-time 4-point payoff, contradicting the duplication claim.
The model_articulation does not describe any clerk behavior that reveals accepted inflated reports or a meta-rule overriding the equal-digit acceptance rule.
